description: Get unified ownership breakdown for a company combining Form 4 insider holdings, 13F institutional holdings, and 13D/13G activist positions. All entities are resolved across the three SEC form types into a single view with counterparty resolution. The allHolders array is paginated via limit/offset (default 100). Aggregate stats (institutional/insider/beneficial/retail totals and percentages) are always included in full.

limit.description: Maximum holders to return in allHolders (default: 100, max: 100)

name: get_ownership
title: Get Comprehensive Ownership
